description: Aeon Trusted Computing Base — every runtime dependency, why it is required, its version pin, and its integrity posture. Absent from automatic model-controlled installation paths.

python_runtime.reason: structural pattern matching, dataclasses, and modern typing used across aeon/

runtime_dependencies.name: torch
runtime_dependencies.reason: AeonTransformer, RecursionJoiner, matrix/vector cells, feedback controller — the entire numerical forward/backward path.
runtime_dependencies.integrity_posture: PyPI + operator-verified index; no auto-install from Aeon runtime.

runtime_dependencies.name: safetensors
runtime_dependencies.reason: Aeon checkpoint I/O — generic tensor format, no external model affiliation.

runtime_dependencies.name: sentencepiece
runtime_dependencies.reason: Aeon's OWN tokenizer trained on Aeon's corpus. Nothing downloaded at runtime.
runtime_dependencies.integrity_posture: PyPI; version-pinned range; no runtime downloads.

runtime_dependencies.name: pyyaml
runtime_dependencies.integrity_posture: PyPI; wide adoption; parsed with safe_load only.

runtime_dependencies.name: numpy
runtime_dependencies.reason: Torch dependency; also used for tokenizer/text helpers.

test_only_dependencies.name: pytest
test_only_dependencies.integrity_posture: PyPI; not on training runtime path.

install_policy.note: Dependencies are installed outside runtime execution (F2.3). Aeon's training/inference/diagnostics scripts do NOT call pip/subprocess to install anything. The primary campaign expects operator-provisioned dependencies matching the pins above.

notes: The environment in which the F0-F9 upgrade was authored uses torch 2.13 as a fallback (the pinned index was not reachable). Documented in docs/E0_REPOSITORY_AUDIT.md; primary training uses the pinned versions.
